intended_object: The canonical embedding of a number field K of degree n into ℂ^n, x ↦ (σ(x))_σ, with σ running over the n field embeddings K → ℂ. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition is the ring homomorphism K → ℂ^{Hom(K,ℂ)} given by RingHom.pi of all embeddings φ : K →+* ℂ, which is exactly the standard canonical embedding. Indexing by the set of embeddings instead of Fin n is the canonical choice. For a number field there are exactly [K:ℚ] embeddings, so the target is ℂ^n, as the docstring says. The definition only assumes [Field K], so it is at least as general as needed, and its content depends on ℂ, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib's NumberField.mixedEmbedding is a different, related object (the map into ℝ^{r₁} × ℂ^{r₂}), so there is no separate counterpart.
